The '''Jinet system''' was a remote and uninhabited [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="FBS" /> Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="CSWE" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] constructed a secret [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base<ref name="FBS" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jinet]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The base's complement of starfighters was a full [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]].<ref name="FBS" />
